description: CI golden metric floors for ImarelloEval synthetic fixtures (no model weights). Catch catastrophic regressions only. GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/eval-floors.yml → Scripts/ci-eval-floors.sh. solid_blue min_technical_score must stay below 40: a flat unclipped field scores Float(40).nextDown (vacuous noise+clip+seam weights in Float32).

unstructured_noise.note: Synthetic white-noise PNG must hard-fail. Catches f16 qmm overflow / broken decode.

optional_generation_floors.note: Only when local 4-bit snapshot + metallib available; not required for swift test
